Author: wolverin0
Message:
fix(routing): smart origin_thread_id + README P0 contract + doc unification

- task.rb: Only default thread_id=25 for group chats (negative Telegram IDs).
  DM chat IDs (positive) now get null thread_id so delivery routes to DM.
- README: Added task_outcome webhook section, fixed findings description,
  added origin routing step to one-prompt install, linked onboarding docs.
- Removed deprecated docs/INTEGRATION.md and docs/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md
  (consolidated into OPENCLAW_ONBOARDING.md + OPENCLAW_INTEGRATION.md).

Author: wolverin0
Message:
feat: Agent integration enhancements

## New Features

### Context Menu Actions
- Move to → submenu (all statuses)
- Create Follow-up action

### Nightly Tasks
- nightly boolean flag + nightly_delay_hours
- Moon emoji badge on cards
- Runs on 'good night' trigger or after delay

### Follow-up System
- parent_task_id linking
- AI-powered suggestions (via external LLM)
- Enhance button for user drafts
- Destinations: inbox, up_next, in_progress, nightly
- Follow-ups inherit parent model

### OpenClaw Gateway Webhook
- Auto-trigger on 'Execute Now' (in_progress + assigned)
- Settings fields for gateway URL + token
- Async job for webhook calls

### AI Suggestion Service
- Model selector in settings (GLM support)
- API key configuration
- Context-aware follow-up suggestions
- Enhance user drafts with task context

### Live Agent Activity
- agent_session_id field for transcript tracking
- GET /tasks/:id/agent_log endpoint

### Documentation
- docs/INTEGRATION.md - comprehensive guide
- Updated settings integration prompt

## Database Migrations
- add_nightly_fields_to_tasks
- add_followup_fields_to_tasks
- add_openclaw_gateway_fields_to_users
- add_ai_settings_to_users
